purpose: Define a governed read-only projection allowing an exact subject to inspect permitted identity, portfolio, merit, message, project and other personal data evidence without granting mutation or cross-subject access.

topics.name: Subject Data Access Projection
topics.purpose: Define a governed read-only projection allowing an exact subject to inspect permitted identity, portfolio, merit, message, project and other personal data evidence without granting mutation or cross-subject access.

semantics.governance_rule: Projection applies applicable visibility/classification/third-party privacy rules.
semantics.third_party_rule: Other people's protected data may be redacted/minimized.
semantics.readonly_rule: Projection is read-only unless separate correction/request operations are explicitly invoked.
semantics.authority_rule: Subject access to own data does not imply access to other protected resources.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: subject identity inferred from browser cookie only

references.purpose: Subject projection binds exact canonical identity.
